description: Backend-neutral golden maneuvers for the dynamic-v1 default, now carrying explicit provenance. Every entry states where its reference authority comes from: measured-carla (executed against CARLA 0.9.16 as physics oracle), published-data (cited external figures), or engine-derived (solver self-checks and not-yet-oracled maneuvers — these are pinned by documentedEngineDerivedIds and any NEW engine-derived entry fails CI). Reference values are never fitted from the run under test.

citations.title: FMVSS No. 135, Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems (S5.1): a passenger car must stop from 62 mph (100 km/h) within 230 ft (70.1 m) on the prescribed surface
Euro NCAP AEB Car-to-Car Test Protocol v4.2 — assessed vehicles deliver dry-pavement emergency deceleration of roughly 0.8-1.0 g (0.90 g nominal)
SAE J1263 / J2263 road-load coastdown measurement (neutral/coast-down procedure); typical passenger-car coefficients give ~0.25 m/s^2 deceleration at 80 km/h
Mainstream sedan/SUV 0-100 km/h acceleration times cluster around 6-10 s depending on engine and mass; the mid-band figure is 8.5 s
ISO 3888-1:2002 Passenger cars — Test track for a severe lane-change manoeuvre — Part 1: Double lane-change. Course sections 15/30/25/25/30 m, gate widths 1.1+B/2 and B+1, lateral lane offset 3.5 m
Skid-pad lateral-grip compendium: typical passenger cars pull 0.7-0.9 g; family sedans about 0.7-0.8 g

references.note: full-throttle launch from standstill, automatic gearbox, Lincoln MKZ 2020, Town01_Opt clear straight, dt=0.02 s
mid-band of the mainstream 6-10 s cluster retained as the real-world anchor

cases.notes: CARLA pedals-released coast measures 1.876 m/s^2 because its powertrain keeps applying drag in drive; SAE J1263 coasts in neutral so the published road-load figure is not comparable to CARLA's protocol. Divergence documented in docs/physics-provenance.md; the fixture keeps the published neutral-coast anchor that the TS road-load model implements.

references.note: pedal applied at first moment v reaches 100 km/h after full-throttle run-up (entry 100.06 km/h), mean decel 7.14 m/s^2, Lincoln MKZ 2020, Town01_Opt

references.derivation: v^2/(2*a_eff) with v = 100/3.6 m/s and a_eff = 8.0 m/s^2 mean deceleration (0.90 g dry-pavement capability less jerk-limited onset)

cases.notes: The CARLA-measured distance (54.1 m) and the Euro-NCAP-derived derivation (48.2 m) differ by ~11%; the widened +-15% band around the CARLA oracle covers both while staying far inside the FMVSS 135 ceiling. TS engine measures 49.53 m, inside the band.

Reference authority is the ISO 3888-1 course geometry itself (published-data); dynamic parity numbers are NOT banded yet: the CARLA oracle runs executed (see docs/physics-provenance.md) but no collision-free gate pass was achieved within this workstream's budget, so no peak-lateral-g reference is claimed rather than fabricated.

Oracle attempts (Town03 roundabout lane-following) produced kinematically invalid samples (radius 0.7 m, >1 g sustained at 24 km/h) because the follower chased junction-interior waypoints; numbers rejected, none fabricated. Pinned engine-derived until a clean constant-radius oracle pass exists.
CARLA step-steer runs at 80/50 km/h ended in wall contact before settling (segment too short for sustained cornering); yaw-gain reference pending a large-area oracle site.
